anti_pattern.name: Orchestration stage explosion
anti_pattern.definition: Do not materialize repeated validator stages as separate run/gate/failure-record orchestration chains when they share the same deterministic authority, contract, tool and recovery semantics and do not create a real control boundary.
signals: The same deterministic validator or contract is invoked repeatedly only with different stage selectors.
Each stage adds near-identical run -> gate -> record-failure boilerplate.
Intermediate gates do not change user interaction, authority, recovery, artifact ownership or downstream reachability in a materially distinct way.
Detailed validation findings belong in the machine report but are duplicated as orchestration structure.
preferred_design: Keep a separate stage only when it creates a real control boundary such as fail-fast parse reachability, a distinct user decision, a distinct authority/tool boundary, a distinct recovery route, or a separately owned artifact/evidence contract.
Aggregate same-authority semantic checks into one authoritative deterministic execution when intermediate orchestration adds no distinct control semantics.
Use gates for routing decisions, not as a visual mirror of every internal validator rule.
Preserve detailed rule-level findings in the deterministic report/evidence rather than expanding the graph solely for visibility.
anti_pattern.non_rule: Node count alone is not a correctness criterion; a larger graph is acceptable when each element represents a distinct responsibility or control boundary.

source_grounding: Documents/38_RESPONSIBILITY_DECOMPOSITION_AND_SUBTREE_ARCHITECTURE.md: overloaded-node correction requires atomic responsibilities, not arbitrary graph inflation.
Documents/91_ALPHA3_REMEDIATION_DOSSIER_ASSESSMENT_FOR_ALPHA4.md: explicitly warns not to blindly create a 200+ node graph for every package file.
JSON validation applied-pilot dogfood: repeated same-validator stage chains were reducible while preserving fail-fast parse and deterministic evidence.
claim_boundary: This is a Vibe authoring anti-pattern/policy. It does not add an Ordo language construct or impose a universal node-count threshold.
